login.heading: Log in
login.intro: Use an account that is already registered.
login.codeSentence: If {{email}} belongs to a registered person, the code arrives in a moment.
login.footer: Only registered people get in. Ask a person who administers the system for access.

login.codeExpired: This code expired. Ask for a new code.
